name: Single-agent CARBOplatin (AUC 7), stage I seminoma adjuvant
cyclesNote: 1 (single-dose adjuvant) or 2 cycles, each at AUC 7

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer - Pure Seminoma
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.AFP: must be normal (a rising AFP excludes pure seminoma)
biomarkers.note: Pure seminoma does not produce AFP; an elevated/rising AFP implies nonseminomatous elements and this adjuvant option would not apply. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer - Pure Seminoma.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: CARBOplatin AUC 7 is moderately-to-highly emetogenic; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier. Confirm exact institutional/guideline tier.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: prophylaxis per CARBOplatin emetogenicity tier.
AUC dosing: compute CARBOplatin dose by the Calvert formula from measured/estimated GFR; verify renal function before dosing.
G-CSF: not indicated for single-agent adjuvant carboplatin.
monitoring: Renal function (creatinine/GFR) before dosing - required for AUC (Calvert) calculation
Serum tumor markers and imaging surveillance per follow-up schedule
clearanceChecks: renal function / GFR for AUC dosing

doseModificationRules.text: Recalculate the AUC-based dose from current GFR (Calvert). Physician decides.

drugs.name: CARBOplatin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, Pure Seminoma SEM-1. CARBOplatin dosed to target AUC 7 (Calvert formula, not mg/m2), day 1 of each cycle. Given as 1 cycle (single-dose) or 2 cycles. Discussion corroborates AUC x 7 (per the formula 7 x [GFR + 25]). Tall-man per ISMP. Limited long-term toxicity/efficacy follow-up for carboplatin in this setting (NCCN footnote l).

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer - Pure Seminoma
provenance.locator: Pure Seminoma stage IA/IB Primary Treatment page (SEM-1): Single-agent Carboplatin (area under the curve [AUC] = 7 x 1 cycle or AUC = 7 x 2 cycles)
